notes.title: Public demo & Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Here we are!

After five years of development, [b]the first public demo of Liam_99 is now public![/b] Which also means the game is...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843948/c4cb6be7fbd736e109315d957bcb671a4417079f.jpg[/img]

It is a crucial step for the project, to which we finally can fully dedicate ourselves since more than a year. Sadly, even though we love our job and going all out to offer you the best game possible, developers do not eat C++ and bugs. It is why we need [b]you[/b] to allow us to go through with this project. In return we prepared oodles of cool rewards, starting off with the game! So... have a look over it, will you?

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/naglfar/liam-99]Liam_99 on Kickstarter[/url]

In any case, we are super grateful for all the support and enthusiasm the project received since the beginning. It is thrilling to eventually let the world meet Liam face to face, and we cannot wait to hear what you thought of this foretaste of Liam_99! See you soon!


Marek & Falko

"It's the beginning of a grand adventure! Or, we can also stay here and... not head off on an adventure. Please make the right choice." - Liam T. Mars
